what_happened.line: The Appointing Committee voted unanimously to reappoint Chris Menard and Jay Simeone to full 3-year Finance Committee terms and appoint Peter Beardmore to a vacant seat.
Beardmore, a former Finance Committee and School Committee member, told the committee the town faces a long-term, not short-lived, fiscal squeeze.
The committee clarified Beardmore is filling roughly two years remaining on a term vacated by a member referred to as "Jean," not Simeone's or Menard's seat.

why_it_matters: These three now sit on the committee that reviews and recommends the town's budget before it goes to town meeting, so who holds these seats affects how budget questions get vetted.
A new member's stated view that fiscal restraint is a sustained condition, not a temporary crisis, may shape how the committee approaches future budget requests.
